feature: PM-authoritative RAG document and chunk scope synchronization

flows.name: Synchronize a stable PM APP scope snapshot
steps: Run per-batch and final whole-snapshot readback
flows.expectedOutcome: The process exits successfully only when every applicable RAG document and chunk matches the stable PM APP source snapshot.

claims.description: Normal and scope-only copy paths reconcile document and chunk scope from one stable source snapshot.
Keyset, count, document, and chunk drift fail with named postconditions.
